test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

Eating foods which have been heated in plastic containers causes cancer, therefore it should be avoided.

**Assumptions:**

(I) Only storing food in plastic containers is not harmful for health.

(II) Non-plastic containers which can be used to heat food are available.

options.text: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.
Both assumptions I and II are implicit.
